subject.title: Bug: Web UI session context not preserved after restart — model can't see history that UI displays

question: Should the linked candidate fix continue as the canonical path after it addresses the one-shot freshness-boundary concern, or should maintainers require a different session-history implementation?
rationale: The issue is valid enough to keep open and has an open closing PR, but the current candidate is blocked by compatibility review around stale session reuse.

options.title: Repair the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask the linked PR to preserve the existing one-shot resume boundary while proving the fresh-page-load WebChat case.

options.title: Accept broader reuse intentionally
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly decide that visible WebChat sessions should override idle/daily freshness, but that would be a session-policy choice.

options.title: Replace with deeper history fix
options.body: Close or supersede the linked PR only if maintainers decide the fix belongs in transcript/history assembly rather than session freshness.

recommendation.title: Repair the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask the linked PR to preserve the existing one-shot resume boundary while proving the fresh-page-load WebChat case.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked decision turns on the one-shot Control UI reconnect/session freshness boundary introduced in their merged work.
